name: Row-Packed Voxel Storage
definition: A memory layout for voxel chunks that reduces memory overhead while maintaining constant-time row access by storing rows as either allocated (with an offset to uncompressed cell data) or unallocated (represented by a single material byte).
summary: Row-Packed Voxel Storage is a memory layout that reduces overhead by compressing uniform rows into a global lookup table while maintaining constant-time access.
